title: Info: only trades toward the nearest daily/weekly pool
question: Daily draw on liquidity: what if trades pointing away from the nearest untaken prior-day / prior-week high or low were skipped?
notes: Method: exact live-loop replay of the live strategy, trades filtered after the fact (a skipped setup gets no replacement trade later that day) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included. Leakage check (run leak_*): memory_seed and exit_learn have no effect on any replay (identical trades), so every comparison uses the live settings as they are.
